참조: [Data Visualization with ggplot2::Cheat Sheet "Zooming"](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/data-visualization.html#zooming)

```{r}
#| code-overflow: wrap
library(ggplot2)
t <- ggplot(mpg, aes(cty, hwy)) + geom_point()
t
```

##### 자르지 않고 확대

```{r}
t + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(10,20))
```

```{r}
#| code-overflow: wrap
t + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100))
```

##### 자르면서 확대(보이지 않는 데이터 제거)

```{r}
#| collapse: true
#| code-overflow: wrap
t + xlim(0, 100) + ylim(10, 20)
```
